name: IMPIC open data of the Portal BASE contracts (dados.gov.pt)
owner: IMPIC, Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção
how: the dataset's public API (https://dados.gov.pt/api/1/datasets/66d72d488ca4b7cb2de28712/) names the yearly file contratos<year>.zip; sources/base-gov-pt/collect.mjs downloads it when it has changed (updated weekly, about 70 MB), stream-parses it in memory and keeps the last 90 days of contracts whose contracting entity is the câmara of Lisboa or of an Algarve municipality, every 6 hours

terms.licence: Outra (Domínio Público), id other-pd, as the dataset's API states on 2026-11-18

notes: dados.gov.pt/robots.txt answered with an HTML error page (HTTP 500) on 18 Nov 2026: no rule readable; only the documented dataset API and the file link are used, 2 to 3 requests a run. Contractors that are natural persons are shown as 'a natural person' (no name, no NIF, no object text). Same file PrompTugal__News__Civic reads (tools/extract-base.mjs); one collector, shared (Dinis, 18 Nov 2026).
